title: 18238 - 18238/P1830/006192
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri from/to Pressure Control Valve 4 (N218) Artı (12V) Kutba Kısa Devre
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri from/to Pressure Control Valve 4 (N218)
technicalNotes:
Pressure Control Valve 4 (N218) might be referred to as Solenoid Valve 7 (N94)
Start with checking connectors for corrosion or water damage, in case of 01V transmission pay special attention to 16-pin connector between valve body and wiring harness.
model: Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, 911, Taycan, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Passat, Golf, Jetta, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco
